title: LightCameraShake
features: A lightweight Roblox LocalScript providing smooth walk and run camera bobbing, mouse-turn camera tilt, spring-driven jump and landing impact without camera pitch distortion, and procedural character body leaning for both R6 and R15 rigs.
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local character, humanoid, rootPart, rootJoint
local originalRootC0 = CFrame.new()

local jumpOffset = 0
local jumpVelocity = 0

local function setupCharacter(char)
 character = char
 humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
 rootPart = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 
 rootJoint = rootPart:FindFirstChild("RootJoint") 
  or (char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") and char.LowerTorso:FindFirstChild("RootJoint"))
 
 if rootJoint then
  originalRootC0 = rootJoint.C0
 end

 humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
  if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
   jumpVelocity = -0.15
  elseif newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
   local fallSpeed = math.abs(rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y)
   local impact = math.clamp(fallSpeed / 35, 0.15, 0.45)
   jumpVelocity = -impact
  end
 end)
end

if player.Character then setupCharacter(player.Character) end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCharacter)

local WALK_INTENSITY = 0.16
local WALK_FREQ = 10

local RUN_INTENSITY = 0.30
local RUN_FREQ = 14

local TILT_INTENSITY = 0.06
local LERP_SPEED = 0.18

local tickCounter = 0
local lastCameraRotation = camera.CFrame
local currentCameraTilt = 0
local currentBobOffset = Vector3.new()
local currentBodyTilt = Vector3.new()

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
 if not humanoid or not rootPart or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

 local velocity = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
 local currentSpeed = velocity.Magnitude
 local isGrounded = humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air

 if currentSpeed > 0.5 and isGrounded then
  local isRunning = currentSpeed > 18
  local intensity = isRunning and RUN_INTENSITY or WALK_INTENSITY
  local freq = isRunning and RUN_FREQ or WALK_FREQ

  tickCounter += deltaTime * freq

  local bobX = math.cos(tickCounter * 0.5) * (intensity * 0.65)
  local bobY = math.abs(math.sin(tickCounter)) * intensity

  currentBobOffset = currentBobOffset:Lerp(Vector3.new(bobX, bobY, 0), LERP_SPEED)
 else
  tickCounter = 0
  currentBobOffset = currentBobOffset:Lerp(Vector3.new(), LERP_SPEED)
 end

 local springStiffness = 180
 local springDamping = 12
 local force = -springStiffness * jumpOffset - springDamping * jumpVelocity
 jumpVelocity += force * deltaTime
 jumpOffset += jumpVelocity * deltaTime

 local deltaCFrame = camera.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(lastCameraRotation)
 local _, yawDelta = deltaCFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
 lastCameraRotation = camera.CFrame

 local targetCamTilt = math.clamp(yawDelta * 1.5, -TILT_INTENSITY, TILT_INTENSITY)
 currentCameraTilt = currentCameraTilt + (targetCamTilt - currentCameraTilt) * LERP_SPEED

 camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame 
  * CFrame.new(currentBobOffset.X, currentBobOffset.Y + jumpOffset, 0)
  * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, currentCameraTilt)

 if rootJoint then
  local localVel = rootPart.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(velocity)
  
  local targetBodyX = -localVel.Z * 0.015
  local targetBodyZ = localVel.X * 0.015
  local targetBodyY = -yawDelta * 0.5

  currentBodyTilt = currentBodyTilt:Lerp(Vector3.new(targetBodyX, targetBodyY, targetBodyZ), LERP_SPEED)

  local bodyBobY = (currentBobOffset.Y * 0.5) + (jumpOffset * 0.7)
  local bodyBobX = currentBobOffset.X * 0.3

  rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0 
   * CFrame.new(bodyBobX, bodyBobY, 0)
   * CFrame.Angles(currentBodyTilt.X, currentBodyTilt.Y, currentBodyTilt.Z)
 end
end)
